text: Vileweb Broodqueen is a venom spider encountered during Island Expeditions.
The Vinyl: Gnomeregan Forever drops from Mechagonian Nullifier and Boggac Skullbash on Mechagon Island.
The Vinyl: Depths of Ulduar drops from a number of rare mobs on Mechagon Island. * Ol' Big Tusk * Boilburn * Gemicide * Earthbreaker Gulroc * The Kleptoboss * Steel Singer Freza
The Vindicators' Sanctum is located in the Vault of Lights in the Exodar. This building houses the paladin trainers of the city, and is described as a chapel by the Exodar Peacekeepers.
Violent Tremors is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Vindicator's Chain Boots are a quest reward from I Shoot Magic Into the Darkness.
Vileweave Cuffs drops from Fel Commander Erixtol in Highmountain and Lord Commander Alexius in Stormheim.
Vileweave Amice drops from Fel Commander Erixtol in Highmountain and Lord Commander Alexius in Stormheim.

Since patch 2.2.0, a VoIP client was built into World of Warcraft and its features include: * The default user interface will display voice chat information, making it easy to identify who is talking. * The interface allows for clicking the portrait of the speaker to allow for easy assisting or healing. * Expanded API to allow interface addons the ability to interact with the voice chat system. * Push-To-Talk as well as auto. * Can talk to party, raid or chat channels. * Mute function (Same as Ignore). * Automatic volume control for in-game sound if you or someone else is talking.

Voggah Deathgrip is an orc quest giver located by the Horde entrance to Alterac Valley in the Hillsbrad Foothills. He was present during the Legion Invasions. Voggah was briefly seen in Frostwolf Village in Alterac Valley when Eitrigg arrived to see Drek'Thar. He was then present at the first Azerothian Kosh'harg in Razor Hill in Durotar.
The Visions of Destruction foretells the battles of the Wildhammer dwarves against the Legion in Shadowmoon Valley.

Vir'naal Dam is a large dam built in central Uldum near the city of Ramkahen. The waters of the Vir'naal contained behind the dam created the biggest water reservoir, known as Vir'naal Lake, in all of Uldum. High Priest Amet is found within the dam. Vir'naal Dam by Nightfall.jpg|Vir'naal Dam at the sunset. Cata-UldumDamNight.jpg|At night.
The Vir'naal River Delta is where the Vir'naal River ends in southern Uldum. Within the delta is the Lost City of the Tol'vir. The Neferset tol'vir control this area.
Viper Venom is a passive Survival hunter ability, available at level 63.

Vir'naal Lake is the largest source of water in Uldum, created when the tol'vir built the Vir'naal Dam so long ago. The city of Ramkahen is located on the northern border, while the small harbor town Mar'at is located on the western side. The date farm on Tahret Grounds is on the eastern side. Sea serpents have invaded the waters soon after the barrier fell around Uldum and lay eggs for future generations of them to spawn forth and further cloud the river. High Priest Amet believes the corruption is being created by the Dark Ritualist Zakahn and that the main source of the problem with him gone is Scalemother Hevna located where the river begins at the northern most part of the Vir'naal Oasi

__NOTOC__ Vizuul the Twisted was an eredar who participated in the battle for the Broken Shore. He summoned three Legion ships to attack the Horde. He was later summoned to Faronaar in Azsuna by adventurers seeking to empower their artifacts through his Twisted Runebindings.
Visser the Scalekeeper is a vrykul flight master located at Valdisdall in Stormheim.
Vlox the Brain-Eater was a wrathguard located near Shattrath City. He was rumored that he could drive a follower insane by just looking at them. He was taken out by them.
The Visual Holo Sphere drops from the Armored Vaultbot on Mechagon Island.

The Vision of Stormwind is a constructed realm that is accessed through the Tenebrous Gateway found in the Chamber of Heart. The Stormwind City shown in here, is not that of the waking world, but the dangers are as real as can be. Once unlocked, a series of altars can be activated to change the experience. The vision can be evacuated via the Expedition Gateway. One Vessel of Horrific Visions is needed per expedition into the vision. Due to the twisted nature of this realm, the sanity of adventurers who brave its dangers is constantly drained. The Titanic Research Archive in the Chamber of Heart can be used to research ways to better withstand the madness of the Old Gods. The research is unlo
The Voice of the Ocean is one of the artifacts of Gral located at Atal'Gral in Zuldazar. It is found next to a Grallian Idol. After using Scroll of Illusion, it turns into a Squishy Sponge.
Visage of Nightmarish Machinations drops from N'Zoth the Corruptor in Ny'alotha, the Waking City.

The Vision of Destiny is the first area of Ny'alotha, the Waking City, where adventurers fight Wrathion, the Black Emperor. The area consists of a large platform floating in a starry expanse, with a shadowy vision of Azeroth behind it. After Wrathion's apparent defeat, players are automatically transported into Ny'alotha proper, and it is revealed that the Vision of Destiny is actually part of the Annex of Prophecy.

Visrynn is a kaldorei Darkfallen dark ranger who remained loyal to Sylvanas Windrunner after the Fourth War and accompanied Nathanos Blightcaller and Sira Moonwarden on their mission to kill the loa Bwonsamdi. Visrynn has dark hair.
Visor of the Firstborn is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.

Visectus is a boneguard located at the Bleak Redoubt in Maldraxxus. Led by Summoner Gerard, a group of Spectral Summoners are attempting to summon it. Members of the Necrolord Covenant can turn in Anima-bound Wraps via the repeatable quest, Specter Of War: Visectus. Once 100 wraps have been turned in, Visectus will begin moving towards the Blackhound Outpost in northern Maldraxxus; players will need to escort the Specter of War to ensure he survives. If Visectus makes it to Blackhand Outpost alive, he will destroy the gate and allow players access to the Blackhound Cache inside.
Vita-Charged Titanshard drops from Ra-den the Despoiled in Ny'alotha, the Waking City.
Vitrified Azerite is an Azerite elemental oozeling located in Island Expeditions.
Visage of Lethality is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Vitality Guillotine is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Vitality Sacrifice is a runecarving power obtained from Memory of a Vital Sacrifice.
Vision of Unending Growth is a runecarving power obtained from Memory of an Unending Growth.
Visage of Ohn'ahra is a statue of Ohn'ahra located at the Trueshot Lodge in Highmountain.
Visage is a dracthyr racial ability. It allows them to switch between their dracthyr and visage forms.
Virid Husks are located in the Blind Marshlands in Highmountain. Interacting them will grant Virid Relief, restoring 5% health every 5 seconds for a minute.
Void Servants are voidwalkers summoned by Void Baron Galaxis in Hellfire Peninsula.
Voidbinder Shadzor is an ethereal item upgrader found in the Hall of Secrets in the Shrine of Two Moons.
Voidbinder Lunshur is an ethereal item upgrader found in the Shrine of Seven Stars.
Voidtalon of the Dark Star is a very rare epic mount that can be found in the Edge of Reality. It is a purple recolor of the Flametalon of Alysrazor.
Voidform is a Shadow priest ability activated by casting Void Eruption.
Void Eruption is a Shadow priest ability. It's used to enter Voidform, during which it transforms into Void Bolt. It is an exclusive choice node with Dark Ascension (priest talent).
Void Bolt is a priest ability that replaces Void Eruption during Voidform.
Void Reflexes is a passive summoned pet ability that increases dodge and parry chance by 10%. It is used by the warlock's Felguard minions.
Void Portal is an ability used by various pets during a Pet Battle.
Vol'jin's Glaive is a destroyer located at the Frostwall Shipyard in Frostfire Ridge.

]] Void ethereals are ethereals who were infused with and reshaped by the power of the Void. Their energies are shadowy dark or red. They also hear maddening whispers that sway them to do the Void's will. Void ethereals are mainly found among the Ethereum, but individuals such as Locus-Walker, who is known for having trained Alleria Windrunner in the ways of the Void, exist as well. The goal of the Ethereum is to "become Void". On Outland, they managed to achieve their goal by manipulating the Void energy from the manaforges and bonding it to their own, creating ethereals known as nexus-stalkers. During the third invasion of the Burning Legion, the Ethereum forces led by Nexus-Prince Bilaal
The Void-Gate Key is located in the Crypt of the Ancients in the Shadowmoon Burial Grounds.

Void Mages were blood elves that were among the followers of Magister Umbric exiled from Quel'Thalas for practicing void magics. They would eventually reach the Telogrus Rift, and would take part in the battle against Nether-Prince Durzaan, the aftermath of which would see the gathered blood elves transformed into the void elf race. Following their transformation, the void elves would pledge their loyalty to Alleria Windrunner, who helped save them from the Nether-Prince, and the Alliance as a whole.
Vol'jin's Invulnerability Totem is sold by Griftah in Dazar'alor. It summons a Worthless Totem.
Void Wands were sold for by Vazun Starspeaker during Island Expeditions.
Voidmender's Shadowgem drops from Nhallish in the Shadowmoon Burial Grounds.
Vol'jamba was a Zandalari troll who was a pupil of Zul. Like Zul, he had the power of Sight. He is located at Tal'gurub in Zuldazar.
The Voidgazer Cap is a quest reward from The Shadowmoon Clan.
The Voidgazer Chain Hood is a quest reward from The Shadowmoon Clan.
The Voidgazer Headcover is a quest reward from The Shadowmoon Clan.
The Voidgazer Headguard is a quest reward from The Shadowmoon Clan.

Void Power Cores are located in the Shirakess Repository in Nazjatar.
Void Elf Representatives are void elves located in Stormwind Embassy in Stormwind City.
The Void Ascendant is a Spellbound Ritualist who turn into void revenant located in Ny'alotha, the Waking City.
Void-Drenched Wristwraps drop from the Hivemind in Ny'alotha, the Waking City.
Void-Twisted Titanshard drops from Ra-den the Despoiled in Ny'alotha, the Waking City.
Void-Etched Band drops from Shad'har the Insatiable in Ny'alotha, the Waking City.
Void Ascendant's Mantle drops from Vexiona in Ny'alotha, the Waking City.
Void Fanatics are goblins and gnomes located in Ny'alotha, the Waking City.
Void Hunters are voidwraiths located in Ny'alotha, the Waking City.
Voidspawn Annihilators are n'raqi located in Ny'alotha, the Waking City.
Voidwraith Signet is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Void Etched Talisman is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.

Voidpriest Sekkta is found at his hut on the northwestern trail from Talador in the northwestern corner of Spires of Arak. Experimenting with void magic, Sekkta used the Fel Grimoire in an attempt to summon and control Gaze, an observer, but failed

.]] Volchan is a rare molten giant found in the western region of the Burning Steppes, patrolling the lava beneath the bridge going into Blackrock Mountain. He used to patrol the perimeter of Dreadmaul Rock along Terror Wing Path, the Ruins of Thaurissan and Morgan's Vigil.

Volatile Mutations are fleshbeast mobs that can be found throughout Ammen Vale on Azuremyst Isle. They were once animals, and have been mutated by radiation seeping from the Exodars power cores. By analyzing samples from the nearby Mutated Root Lashers, Botanist Taerix managed to create a Neutralizing Agent capable of returning these creatures to their original forms.
Voren'thal the Seer is a blood elf quest giver located in the Seer's Library of the Scryer's Tier in Shattrath City. He is the leader of the Scryers faction.
Voodoo Mantle was a quest reward from Jin'Zil's Forest Magic.

Vordrassil's Heart is one of the three major segments of the World Tree Vordrassil that fell to earth after it was destroyed long time ago by the night elves. It is located southwest of Grizzlemaw within the Grizzly Hills. The entire area around it is covered in living ooze, evidence of Vordrassil's corruption.

Vordrassil Pass is a passage through a major portion of the trunk of the fallen World Tree Vordrassil, directly adjacent to the city of Grizzlemaw that grew within its stump. The path through the pass goes north then shifts northeast to the Westfall Brigade Encampment and Ursoc's Den. Ruuna's Camp is located directly next to Vordrassil Pass.

Vordrassil's Limb is one of the three major segments of the World Tree Vordrassil that fell to earth after it was destroyed long time ago by the night elves. It is located directly north of Amberpine Lodge. The entire area around it is covered in living ooze, evidence of Vordrassil's corruption.

Vordrassil's Tears is one of the three major segments of the World Tree Vordrassil that fell to earth after it was destroyed long time ago by the night elves. It is located southwest of the Blue Sky Logging Grounds. The entire area around it is covered in living ooze, evidence of Vordrassil's corruption.

__NOTOC__ Volcanoth is an immense fire turtle which dwells in Volcanoth's Lair and is worshipped as a god by the pygmies of the Lost Isles, but it's not really a god according to Hobart Grapplehammer. The pygmies have been sacrificing the captured inhabitants of the Town-In-A-Box to the massive creature. After Volcanoth is killed by the goblin adventurer, the volcano in which it dwelled erupts, setting much of the island ablaze.
Vorrel's Wedding Ring drops from Nancy Vishas in Alterac Mountains.
Vor'Illian was the twin of Lo'Vellian. The pair wielded the magical swords Shalla'tor and Ellemayne during the War of the Ancients.

The Vortex Pinnacle is the level 82-84 five-man wing in the Skywall complex, accessed at via the floating spires off the southeastern Uldum coast, introduced in World of Warcraft: Cataclysm. Queuing for the Vortex Pinnacle through the Dungeon Finder requires level 82 and an average item level of 272. Here the armies of Al'Akir reside, and will not take kindly to any intruders in his elemental plane. The air elementals have entered an unholy alliance with the Worldbreaker, Deathwing and now threaten the denizens of Uldum. It is up to the adventurers to stop the elemental incursion to the ancient land, and the task is uneasy as they have to face the most powerful lieutenants of the Windlord.
Volcanoth's Lair is a cave located inside a dormant caldera on the largest island of the Lost Isles. Volcanoth currently resides inside.
The Volcanic Deck can be turned in for Darkmoon Card: Volcano.

__NOTOC__ During the first phase of the fight against Alysrazor, she will fly above the raid and you will have to deal with two types of adds - Blazing Talon Initiate and Voracious Hatchling. The Hatchlings, will spawn as a pair early in this stage and will fixate on the player closest to their egg. After some time, the Hatchlings will grow hungry and their melee attacks will give them 20% chance to throw a Tantrum.
Volcano is an ability used by Dragon Kite during a Pet Battle.
Volux is a rare mob wasp located at Thal'darah Grove in the Stonetalon Mountains.
This item increases your carry capacity of Ancient Mana by 100.
Volatile Devastator Rounds are piles of ammunition located in Darkfall Ridge in Krokuun. They will explode when damaged.

The Vor'thik are a group of mantid found in Dread Wastes. They embraced the sha, using its power to fuel their march in this false swarm. Their warriors consume tainted amber and call themselves dreadsworn.
Volunteer Farmhands are humans located in the Wollerton Stead in Stormwind City following the Burning of Teldrassil. They are seen collecting pumpkins grown by Darnassian Druids.
The Voodoo Hall is a voodoo lounge in the new Darkspear tribe village in Dustwallow Marsh in Old Hatreds. Rexxar can buy magical items there.
Voru'kar Spitters are nerubian flyers located on the expedition isles.

The Volatile Worldvein is a quest reward from Azerite for the Alliance or Azerite for the Horde, a weekly quest to collect Azerite on Island Expeditions. Infusing the item at the Heart Forge will grant Rank 1 of the Worldvein Resonance Essence and leave behind a pile of Inert Mineral Dust.
Volatile Cure-all can be found on Island Expeditions. It is used to cure poisoned NPCs.

__NOTOC__ Vortrexxis is the personal necropolis of Margrave Krexus, floating above the House of the Chosen in southwestern Maldraxxus. It is normally unreachable but is visited via a teleporter during Meet the Margrave.
Volatile Animastores are located in the Citadel of Loyalty in Bastion. They can be destroyed.
Volatile Augury is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
__NOTOC__ Volshas is a saurok located in Island Expeditions.

Volcanic Plumage is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Volatile Shadestitch Legguards are dropped by Hungering Destroyer in Castle Nathria.

]] Vombata are a type of prototype creature found in the Shadowlands origin realm Zereth Mortis. Gentle and kind, they originally approached the brokers who would become Enlightened. They are generally peaceful herbivores, but are capable of powerful headbutts in self defense. Several colors of vombata are obtainable as mounts by players, and encountered across the realm.

The vorquin are quadrupedal dragonkin native to the Dragon Isles. They serve as the racial mounts of the dracthyr and are respected for their resilience in battle, even against dragonfire. The more powerful armored vorquin are trained using ancient dracthyr methods and embody the pinnacle of tactical mounted ground warfare.
Sentinel Osar is a nightborne flight master located at Emberwatch in the Ohn'ahran Plains.

Volatile Frostfire is contained in Renewed Dream while on Our Full Strength. They also drop from Frost Shacklers and Hydro Pugilists directly while on the quest. Use it to free Gerithus, Emerald Scaleguards, and Wardens.
Volcanic Equipment Chest is sold by Spinsoa in Loamm, Zaralek Cavern in exchange for 250 Flightstones. It contains a random Adventurer 4 (ilvl 398) piece.

WANTED: Baron Vardus is a Horde quest in Hillsbrad Foothills that involves killing Baron Vardus, a ranking member of the Syndicate in the Alterac Mountains. You must have completed WANTED: Syndicate Personnel in order to get this quest.

The vrykul (pronounced /ˈvɹɑɪkuɫ/ or "VRYE-kool") are a race of fearsome half-giant warriors that live mostly in Northrend and are known for their close affinity with the sea and with the continent's native proto-dragons. They are descended from titan-forged iron vrykul that were afflicted with the Curse of Flesh and are in turn the progenitors of the human race, who were originally vrykul children that were born weak and deformed as a result of the curse. Vrykul Archaeology Fragments are found using the Survey ability of the Archaeology skill. As with all Archaeology Fragments, they are not inventory items but instead tracked on the relevant page of a player's archaeology dialog. These fragments are found at Vrykul archaeology sites.

Vrykul Male Mask is a mask that can be used by players at any level that not only places a the mask on the players face, but also provides a small buff. This mask increases your strength by 35 (for level 85 players).

Vrykul Female Mask is a mask that can be used by players at any level that not only places a the mask on the players face, but also provides a small buff. This mask increases your strength by 35 (for level 85 players).

Vrekt was a vrykul village and harbor before it was destroyed by a landslide in southern Stormheim. While naga typically infest the area, Helarjar forces may sometimes appear to carry out the plans of Helya.

Vulajin is a jungle troll or gnome (depending on the player's faction) rogue and a member of the Uber Town guild. He can be briefly seen during the flashback of the confrontation with Illidan Stormrage atop the Black Temple.

Vydhar was a vrykul turned into a tree located in the Runewood in Stormheim. He was transformed with the help of the Highmountain tauren many ages ago, his wisdom made eternal. During the third invasion of the Burning Legion, the Bonespeakers twisted the woods around him, severely weakening the tree sage. He was rescued by the arrival of a hero sent by Havi, seeking to fulfill their Trial of Valor. After the hero rescued him from the Bonespeakers, Vydhar agreed to help them speak to the spirits of ancient vrykul rulers if they could gather an aromatic to burn and an offering to present to them. He then pointed the heroes to the ancient kings, but not before asking that the heroes lay the spi

The vulpera (pronounced "vuhl-PEH-ruh") are a race of nomadic fox people that inhabit the deserts of Vol'dun on Zandalar. Intelligent and resourceful, they travel across the dunes in caravans and survive by scavenging and trading. Though long hunted and enslaved by the sethrak of the Faithless empire, the vulpera found the strength to fight back after being aided by Horde adventurers in Vol'dun and have now pledged their loyalty to the Horde. Some vulpera can also be found across the sea, most notably as members of the Bilge Rats pirate crew in Kul Tiras.
Vrykul Necrolords are vargul located at Sindragosa's Fall in Icecrown. Empowered versions appeared during Death Rising.

__NOTOC__ Vulpera Slaves are vulpera that have been enslaved by Faithless sethrak in various locations throughout Vol'dun. Many are found in the Crater of Conquerors and need to be armed for Ready to Riot. Others are seen being sold by Faithless Dealers at slave auctions in the Slithering Gulch, but can be freed if the corresponding Dealer is killed. During Vengeance From Above, they can be seen fighting Faithless Oppressors, Faithless Ravagers, Faithless Slavers, and Faithless Eradicators in Skycallers' Spire. Yet other slaves are forced by Sethrak Wardens to mine :Azerite in the Blistering Wastes and the dunes near Vol'dun's southwestern mountains.
__NOTOC__ Vudax is an n'raqi that can be encountered during Island Expeditions.
__NOTOC__ Vyrantion is a twilight dragon that can be encountered during Island Expeditions.
Vyliss is a saurok of the Slitherblade clan encountered in Island Expeditions.
Vorzz Yoq'al drops from Dark Inquisitor Xanesh in Ny'alotha, the Waking City.
Vradira Livid is a Maldraxxi necromancer flight master located at Plague Watch in Maldraxxus.
Vya Crystalbloom is a crystal dryad located in the Verdant Wilds during Island Expeditions.
Vy'lix the Corpse-Mauler is a beetle located in Island Expeditions.
__NOTOC__ Vulf Stormshore is a kvaldir located in the Dread Chain during Island Expeditions.

Mekgineer Thermaplugg's obsession for explosives shows, for whenever he is threatened, the many bomb machines start up and begin producing explosive protectors, the Walking Bombs, for their master. Be wary of these machines, and deactivate them as soon as Thermaplugg starts them up with a bolt of electricity from his Mechanical Battle-Mount that he is never without. Be sure to close these machines by pressing the buttons located on the sides immediately.
Wailing Nightbane Pauldrons are a pair of Level 42 quality Plate Pauldrons that improve Strength, Stamina and Dodge.

Walking scabbard is a Forsaken gladiator owned by the goblin Sparkeye. His real name is unknown but Valeera Sanguinar called him "walking scabbard" because of the swords in his ribcage. He and his teammates, Trusk and Maggore, attacked Rehgar Earthfury's team—Lo'Gosh, Broll Bearmantle and Valeera Sanguinar. In the end Sparkeye's team was beaten and Walking scabbard destroyed. However, his master noted that a necromancer could put the undead back together.

The Wailing Ziggurat is a Scourge ziggurat located south of the Temple City of En'kilah. Thassarian, as leader of "Unit S", led an attack to claim this ziggurat and now uses it as a base to find a way into the necropolis of Naxxanar — where he believes the hidden infiltration of Valiance Keep by the Cult of the Damned is based.

Walk in the Light is one of the passive specialization bonuses for the Holy tree for the Paladin class. All paladins who specialize in the Holy tree will automatically and instantly have this ability.
The Wand of Untainted Power drops from Forgemaster Throngus in Grim Batol.

Walpole's Bodyguards are the bodyguards of Commander Walpole, who stands outside the gates of Honor's Stand in what is technically considered the Southern Barrens but is more part of Stonetalon Mountains.
Waina Steelpaw is a pandaren located by Merra Finklestorm in the Shrine of Seven Stars
__NOTOC__ Wally is a tuskarr found with on a small island at the center of the north shore of Kun-Lai Summit.
Waffle Joe is found in the house of Kelly Aguilar in Stormwind City.

The Wakeners were an order of eredar magi led by the sorcerer Thal'kiel several years before Sargeras' arrival on Argus. They were eventually destroyed by the eredar leadership for consorting with demons and attempting to install Thal'kiel as dictator of Argus. The symbol of the Wakeners is the Scythe-like object seen on the draenei banners.
Waiting for Gerdo is an achievement rewarded for disabling each of the Watchposts during the Patrol Captain Gerdo encounter in the Court of Stars on Mythic difficulty.
Wake of Ashes is a Retribution paladin ability, learned from Ashbringer (artifact).

WKM is a secret room found within an escarpment in Orgrimmar. It was added when the city was redesigned with the release of Cataclysm. The 3D artist, Chad Max, who was working on the project, hid this area as an homage to his father William Kenneth Max. For many years it had been unknown what the point of this room was, though it was rumored to be a tribute to Michel Koiter, a deceased Blizzard employee.
__NOTOC__ Walcott Sutton is a human located at the Stormwind Harbor in Stormwind City. He works as a blacksmith for the naval fleet.
These wallpapers were officially released by Blizzard Entertainment for the Warcraft universe.
Wallaby is a pug located in Redridge Pass in Redridge Mountains. During Tracking Tipoff. If Hunter McAlister‎ is killed first, Wallaby runs away.

The Wallace's Warriors are a collection of fellow tinkers of their leader, Wallace Boltscrew. They are valuable additions to Falrevere's Bloodsail Buccaneers. Wallace and the other tinkers improve the Buccaneers by adding technology to their equipment. Armored plating and more powerful cannons were only the ﬁrst step; Wallace has tried numerous other experiments as well and has slain only a dozen or so sailors testing them. Wallace and his lover, Annetta Crank, have crafted several submarines that could prove extremely dangerous; Duke Falrevere is holding these vessels secretly beneath Bloodsail Hold for now, for fear of tipping his hand to the Blackwater Raiders before he is ready.
__NOTOC__ Wall-Breaker Ha'vik is a kunchong encountered during Island Expeditions.
Wailing Pendant is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Wailing Visage is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Wailing Arrow is a hunter ability granted by Rae'shalare, Death's Whisper, which drops from Sylvanas Windrunner in the Sanctum of Domination.

The Waistguard of Fel Magics drops from Matron Folnuna in Cen'gar and Inquisitor Meto in Naigtal.

War Academy is a Tier 1 talent in the Warrior's Arms tree. It increases the damage of attack abilities used by all three warrior trees, and is considered useful for any spec.
The war between the titans and the Old Gods was a conflict fought eons ago by the titan-forged against the armies of the Black Empire on the main continent of Azeroth known as Kalimdor.

War-God Al'chukla is an elite Zandalari troll. He appears during Tear Down This Wall! (quest), being personally charged by Lei Shen to guard the Conqueror's Terrace from the forces of the Alliance and Horde after being blessed by his lightning powers. He is killed at the end of the scenario, exploding due to the lightning.

__NOTOC__ War-God Dokah is a rare Zandalari warlord. He is a leading member of the Zandalari Beast Ward, a division of the Zandalari military dedicated to breeding, supplying and empowering beasts of war for conquest. He is found on a boat off the coast of the Isle of Giants surrounded by Zandalari Dinomancers.
Wanderluster: Bronze is awarded for completing The Real Race at the Darkmoon Faire with the Wanderluster within 20 tolls, the second in a series of four.
Wanderluster: Silver is awarded for completing The Real Race at the Darkmoon Faire with the Wanderluster within 15 tolls, the third in a series of four.

Wanderluster: Gold is awarded for completing The Real Race at the Darkmoon Faire with the Wanderluster within 11 tolls, the fourth in a series of four. Players who earn this achievement will be awarded the Attraction Sign.

The war between the Breakers and the Primals is a conflict in Gorgrond between the plant-composed Primals, and the savage Breakers. While the botani, podlings and genesaur attempt to grow, spread and flourish like the plants they consist of, the gronn, goren and magnaron seek to expand into the jungle and kill its inhabitants for both food and for the fun of battle. Durotan claims that this conflict has been waged since time immemorial and must continue, for if one side were to lose, all of Draenor would fall to the victor. Waning Crescent is the cave passage that leads to Light's Fall. It's full of Voidborne Errants. Deep in the cave, there are Shadowmoon Voidwhisperers channeling a Dark Emanation.

__NOTOC__ The Waning Glacier is an area in northwestern Tiragarde Sound. It serves as the home for a pack of Snowpelt wolves, groups of penguins and, most importantly, an ever-expanding host of yeti led by the fierce Whompus. The latter predators threaten the gryphon-taming camps and travelers below their frigid abode. A handful of hawks also nest in the slopes. A Horde flight point is hidden on the western side of the area, nestled between a small rise and the slopes themselves; some of the Snowpelt wolves serve as unknowing sentinels to this simple camp.

The War Supply Crates are drops in various locations either by a zeppelins or flying machines respectively. Some zones uses one of them specifically. Using the crate will unlock it and convert it to the player's faction War Supply Chest for players to collect but getting attacked will interrupt the use effect. It was also available in Darkshore during the War of the Thorns event.

The War Supply Chests are created from the War Supply Crates that drop from zeppelins or flying machines. These chests were also available in Darkshore during the War of the Thorns event with unique loot.

__NOTOC__ War Krolusks are small krolusks that accompany the Faithless forces in the Blistering Wastes (while Azerite Mining (Vol'dun) is available) and the dunes near the southwestern mountains in Vol'dun.
War-Torn Mementos are sold for by Lieutenant Elda and Provisioner Burg during Island Expeditions.
War Effort Recruits were level 30 orcs assisting with the Ahn'Qiraj war effort in the Valley of Spirits in the orc city of Orgrimmar.
__NOTOC__ Wander's Colossal Book of Shadow Puppets is a flying tome located in The Reliquary in Scholomance as part of the Instructor Chillheart encounter.
__NOTOC__ Wandering Tale is a flying tome located in Ardenweald.
The War of the Scaleborn was a major war between the dragons of the dragonflights and the Primalist proto-dragons, fought in around 20,000 BDP.

Warcraft III: Reign of Chaos is a computer game released by Blizzard Entertainment in 3 July 2002. It is a real-time strategy computer game, the second sequel to Warcraft: Orcs & Humans and the third game set in the Warcraft universe. As such, it is usually referred to as Warcraft III, often abbreviated to WC3 or WCIII. Warcraft III is also considered to be one of Canada's national sports (along with hockey and lacrosse), due to the high level of top WCIII gamers that come from Canada and due to the occasional televised broadcast of the game, especially in British Columbia. Warbreaker was an Arms warrior ability granted by Strom'kar, the Warbreaker.

The Warbraves are a Horde team that can be encountered on Island Expeditions. They can also be found idling in the Port of Zandalar along with the other teams.

Warcraft Adventures: Lord of the Clans trailer was released for the adventure game that was ultimately canceled. It is notable for introducing the character of Thrall and that the story told in the trailer matches the story canon of future iterations of the main Warcraft universe (even though the rest of the unreleased game was greatly different from future official Warcraft story).

Warcraft II: Combat Edition, often abbreviated as War2Combat, is an unofficial stripped-down version of Warcraft II: Battle.net Edition that is specifically designed for portability and ease-of-use. It provides the user to play on third-party servers instead of the Battle.net servers (which are no longer available) without a CD-key and adds additional new features and bug fixes that is designed to improve the multiplayer gaming experience. Version 4.01 restored the original single-player campaigns, which can now be played in addition to connecting to an online multiplayer server. It also works with the official GOG.com server (and checks the CD-keys).

It is part of the History of Warcraft which is made up of all the published sources so far. Most of the information there is about elves. Since the release of the first Warcraft game, the lore of the Warcraft universe has been evolving and expanding at an incredible rate. Today, Warcraft lore is spread across four games and three expansions as well as a number of novels, a pen-and-paper roleplaying game, and even a manga series. Warhorses are a type of horse used as war mounts. They are used by the Forsaken (and other Horde races if with Undercity), paladins and other players by other means. They are trained to act counter to their instincts.

Warden Belamoore was a human mage from Dalaran found in the Alterac Mountains. With the replacement of the Lordamere Internment Camp by the Brazie Farmstead, Warden Belamoore is now nowhere to be seen.

Warden Thelwater is a human quest giver who presided over the Stormwind Stockade, a high-security prison complex, hidden beneath the canal district of Stormwind City, and the home to petty crooks, political insurgents, murderers, and a score of the most dangerous criminals in the land.

This article looks at the general physics evident in the Warcraft games. Some of the examples can be traced to gameplay restrictions, and the info given here should not be taken as the exact workings of the Warcraft universe.

Warden's Cage is an Illidari Servitor-run prison located west of the Black Temple in Shadowmoon Valley. It was where Warden Maiev Shadowsong, the former jailor of Illidan Stormrage, was held prisoner by Broken servitors led by Akama himself. Judging by the architecture and torn drapes, the area appears to be a ruined fel orc facility.

Warden's Arrows were the third highest-damage-output arrows available in from a vendor, just after Timeless Arrow and Mysterious Arrow, though the reputation restriction on their purchase still makes Blackflight Arrows the best arrow without any restriction.

World Editor loading screen]] World Editor loading screen]] World Editor loading screen]] :The Technical Support team of Blizzard Entertainment does not directly support the Warcraft III editor. HiveWE is a recreation of the world editor designed by Hive Workshop that is meant to replace and improve on the Warcraft III editor. The Warcraft III World Editor is a powerful tool that allows manipulating almost every aspect of the game. It can be used to edit existing maps or to create custom maps and campaigns. The World Editor has built up a huge community of map making enthusiasts who share their work online with others through various sites dedicated to map-making and modding in Warcraft III.

Wardens of Time are bronze drakonid guards of the bronze dragonflight found patrolling the Caverns of Time in Tanaris. During Children's Week, two rush towards Salandria / Dornaa, but are stopped by Zaladormu. During the Warcraft's Anniversary event, when the two factions fight, they proceed to stop them.
The warlock has the unique ability to summon various minions. See individual pages or Minion for details.

Warlock curses are warlock abilities that debuff the opponent. Only one curse per warlock can be active on a target at any time. Curses do not stack with those cast by another warlock. All Warlock curses are instant cast, have a 40 yd range and no cooldown.
Warcraft III Player's Guide is the title of a cancelled D&D campaign book set in the Warcraft universe.
Warglaives of Azzinoth is the Feat of Strength achievement for equipping a set of from Black Temple.

Warlord's Command was the Horde quest chain that leads to obtaining the Drakefire Amulet, the key to Onyxia's Lair. This is one of the most arduous quest chains in the game, involving killing a variety of powerful elite creatures across the world as well as a raid in Upper Blackrock Spire. It may require several Lower Blackrock Spire runs as well, to acquire the key to the raid area.
Warden's Vigil is part of the main prison complex on Tol Barad. Horde and Alliance forces will battle over it to gain control of the island.

Warden's Chambers is a room within The Hole on the island of Tol Barad. It served as Warden Silva's office and an important center for the cellblock while active. After the death of the Warden, it is where the Warden's spirit stands guard.
The Warden's Scroll Case is found at inside the Warden's Cage of Shadowmoon Valley on Outland. The scroll case contains Music Roll: The Black Temple for players who have completed Bringing the Bass.
Wards, Sigils, and the Nightborne Way is looted from Scrolls, Sigils, and the Nightborne Way in the Court of Stars. After the quest is completed, the book is seen in Shal'Aran in Suramar.
This page is used to archive the abilities used by creeps in Warcraft III.

Warfang Hold is the Horde's foothold in northern Stormsong Valley. It is phased along with many unique NPCs such as General Blackstone and Zeryna Wrin and destroyed by the Alliance during Eye for an Eye (Stormsong Valley). It is later attacked again during Faction Assaults.
